title: Check item IDs against Google Sheet tabs

toolu_01JsZunKqp39qJhgASb5J5cW.prompt:
从Wonder的Cookbook系统中查询以下4个item的名称（item name/sku name）：
- 4001001
- 4001074
- 4001195
- 4001213

请访问Cookbook系统或使用相关的CLI命令查询这些item的具体名称。如果有可用的Cookbook API或CLI，请使用它来获取这些信息。

toolCalls.name: Bash

input.command: which cookbook || which cookbook-cli || ls -la ~/bin/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i cookbook || echo "检查环境变量和常见路径..."

toolCalls.result:
cookbook not found
cookbook-cli not found
检查环境变量和常见路径...

input.description: Search for cookbook-related tools in home directory

input.args: 查询以下4个item的名称（item name/sku name）：4001001, 4001074, 4001195, 4001213

input.command:
export PATH="/Users/bonnie/Downloads/google-cloud-sdk/bin:$PATH" && bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty '
SELECT
  item_number,
  name
FROM `secure-recipe-prod.recipe_v2.effective_items`
WHERE deleted = false
  AND item_status != "DORMANT"
  AND item_number IN ("4001001", "4001074", "4001195", "4001213")
ORDER BY item_number
'
input.description: Query Cookbook item names from effective_items table
